none: PAS FindID 995635: Roman Coin: Numus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17 on a worn round brown flan. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right, seen from front, long neck. Obverse inscription: [---]AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths aloft; possibly a Z between figures. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]. Diameter: 14.9mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die axis: 12
